title: Exam Arena — Whole-App UI Audit

method.tool: Playwright chromium against static export (out/) on localhost:3008
limitations: No visual/pixel review (model cannot view images); findings are computed-style + DOM semantics only.
Contrast measured from computed color vs nearest opaque ancestor background; elements over gradients/images are flagged as likely false positives.
Accessible-name check is heuristic (aria-label / innerText / img alt / title).

macro_bets.description: Ship study features (learn/play/settings) quickly on a shared app shell.
One design-token system (globals.css) drives both themes across 40 routes.
Exam-prep accuracy depends on readable analytics/progress data.

jtbd.situation: I open the app to resume studying
jtbd.motivation: see where I stand and what to do next
jtbd.outcome: start the right practice without hunting
target the topics that cost me marks

jtbd.situation: I want to tune my account

global_findings.title: Chart palette not re-tuned for light mode
global_findings.detail: Light block darkens --chart-1/--chart-5 but leaves --chart-3 (#F59E0B) and --chart-4/#8B5CF6 untouched, producing sub-AA text on light surfaces.

global_findings.title: Icon-only nav links are unlabeled
global_findings.detail: Collapsed sidebar hides label text and the icon is aria-hidden -> no accessible name across every app route.

global_findings.title: Most screens lack an H1
global_findings.detail: 21/40 routes have no h1; hierarchy starts at h2/h3.

global_findings.title: Small interactive controls
global_findings.detail: Carousel dots, notification badge, accent swatches, theme toggle, and several pills are under 44px.

global_findings.title: Layout stability is excellent
global_findings.detail: Zero horizontal overflow across 40 routes x 6 viewport/theme combos; nav/sidebar switch correctly at the 1025px boundary; exam routes suppress the bottom nav.

global_findings.title: Reduced-motion supported
global_findings.detail: prefers-reduced-motion media query present in the stylesheet.

priority_fixes.title: Darken chart palette in light theme (amber especially)
priority_fixes.description: `--chart-3: #F59E0B` is identical in dark and light blocks, so amber text (text-chart-3) renders at 1.88-2.36:1 on light surfaces. The light block already darkens --chart-1 and --chart-5 but skips --chart-3. Add a darkened amber for light mode.

priority_fixes.title: Give icon-only sidebar links an accessible name
priority_fixes.description: Collapsed sidebar nav links render only an aria-hidden icon with the text label hidden until hover, so screen readers announce nothing. Add aria-label (or sr-only text) to each nav link.

priority_fixes.title: Add a page H1 to heading-less routes
priority_fixes.description: 21 routes start at h2 or have no heading at all, so there is no programmatic page title. Promote each screen's title to an h1.

priority_fixes.title: Label carousel pagination + notification badge buttons
priority_fixes.description: Hero carousel dots are <button> at 8x8/20x8 with no accessible name, and the notification badge button (20x20) is unnamed. Add aria-label and enlarge hit area to >= 44px.

priority_fixes.title: Raise sub-44px tap targets
priority_fixes.description: Accent swatch (36x36), theme toggle (48x24), 'Details' pill (h29), 'PRACTICE NOW'/'EXPLORE TECHNIQUES' (h31), 'VIEW HABITS' (h41) fall below 44px. Increase min height or pad the hit area.

priority_fixes.title: Mark current location on subroutes
priority_fixes.description: aria-current is only set on top-level routes; subroutes (/dashboard/analytics, /settings/*) never mark the active item, so wayfinding is weaker. Derive active state from pathname prefix.

priority_fixes.title: Fix /learn heading skip and /play duplicate landmarks
priority_fixes.description: /learn jumps h1 -> h3 (cards should be h2). /play renders 2 main and 2 nav landmarks (likely an inline duplicate/overlay).
priority_fixes.evidence: learn page cards; play page landmark counts

notes: Audit is mechanical, not aesthetic. High-confidence real issues: light-mode amber/chart contrast (GF-1), unnamed icon-only nav links (GF-2), missing H1s (GF-3), sub-44px controls (GF-4). Confirmed false positives excluded from counts: gradient CTA buttons (bg-cta uses linear-gradient so computed background-color is transparent), white text on .keep-white image cards, the 1x1 sr-only 'Skip to content' link, and low body text on form/canvas routes (/settings/profile/edit, /play/sprint, /learn/mock/run).
